_comment: Example registry. Copy to agents.json (or point RELAY_AGENTS_FILE at it). The DAEMON normally writes this via /admin/register; you can also hand-edit it. agent_id + token are 256-bit secrets the daemon mints — never the relay.

_paths._comment: OPTIONAL global slug->local-path overrides. Prefer identity mapping and let the daemon remap. Only the blessed exception (e.g. a sendblue secret baked into the path) belongs here.

coldhook._comment: Per-hook shared token (spec §4). Provider must send ?token=... or X-Relay-Token: ...

stripe._comment: HMAC-verified at the edge (spec §3.3). hmac_header + per-provider canonicalization may be needed; see registry._verify_hmac.
